selected_leaf: Derive a minimal read-only verifier state machine over VERIFY_PENDING, UNKNOWN, COMMITTED and CONFLICT that consumes the predecessor closure-to-coverage contract without ever converting UNKNOWN into a retry mutation.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat Stage T verification for one already-issued submission S bound to logical_effect_id and request digest d. The verifier is read-only; this slice performs no second target mutation and claims no concrete provider/API capability.

evidence_basis.method: deterministic local derivation from the predecessor effect-relative closure-to-coverage contract; no public, cross-role, O, downstream, legacy, or shared-ledger semantic input

state_semantics.VERIFY_PENDING: No authoritative verifier observation has yet been durably classified for the current verification attempt; only read-only observation is permitted.
state_semantics.UNKNOWN: A verifier observation completed but lacked one or more terminal prerequisites: authoritative S/d correlation, effect-relative closure A(S), complete effect emission, covers(H,A(S)), or a matching committed witness. UNKNOWN is nonterminal and never authorizes a retry mutation.
state_semantics.COMMITTED: A uniquely correlated target-authoritative committed-effect witness E(S,d) is observed. This is terminal for the logical effect under the assumed target contract.
state_semantics.CONFLICT: S is authoritatively closed, complete effect emission holds, a target-defined coverage witness H proves covers(H,A(S)), and no matching committed E(S,d) exists through H. This terminally proves the already-issued S did not and cannot later commit without a new mutation.

transition_function.observation: A(S) final plus complete emission plus covers(H,A(S)) plus covered absence of E(S,d)
any missing/uncertain closure, emission, correlation, comparability, coverage or finality prerequisite
later read-only observations consistent with the same authoritative witness
later read-only observations consistent with the same final closure/coverage certificate

monotone_witnesses.matching_commit_witness: Monotone only when the target defines E(S,d) as durable/authoritative; once accepted it absorbs COMMITTED.
monotone_witnesses.closure_certificate: Monotone only when A(S) is target-final for all descendants causally creatable by S; client timeout is not monotone closure evidence.
monotone_witnesses.coverage_frontier: Monotone only within a target-defined comparable domain or causal bridge; a later numerically larger unrelated counter is not stronger evidence.
monotone_witnesses.terminal_covered_absence: Monotone only as the conjunction of final closure, complete emission and coverage domination; then CONFLICT is absorbing for the same S/d.
monotone_witnesses.checkpointed_unknown: Monotone only as knowledge that a particular observation was insufficient; it does not imply future absence or permission to mutate.

nonterminal_observations: no matching effect before effect-relative closure
closure known but verifier coverage does not dominate it
coverage token present but complete effect emission is unproven
uncorrelated or ambiguously correlated target events
eventual-consistency lag with no target-authoritative coverage certificate
timeout, elapsed age, transport error, rate-limit response, or missing read
bounded_leaf_result.retry_safety_rule: UNKNOWN may schedule only a future read-only re-observation after durable checkpoint. It must never be reinterpreted as permission to reissue, retry, repair, or otherwise mutate the target. Any later target mutation requires a separate independently authorized protocol state and cannot be inferred from this verifier state machine.
bounded_leaf_result.contradiction_rule: If a target later presents a valid E(S,d) after a previously accepted CONFLICT certificate, or denies a previously accepted durable commit witness, classify the target contract/evidence assumptions as violated and reopen an unresolved protocol-validity child; do not silently flip terminal states or issue a compensating mutation.
bounded_leaf_result.direct_architecture_contribution: The recurring-Chat agent can remain safe across crash windows by persisting only monotone verifier knowledge: authoritative commit, final closure, comparable coverage, or explicit insufficiency. Because UNKNOWN has no mutation edge, stale or repeated invocations cannot turn epistemic uncertainty into duplicate external effects.

contradictions: A terminal CONFLICT followed by authoritative E(S,d) would contradict the assumed closure/coverage/emission contract and must reopen protocol validity rather than mutate the target.
A provider that cannot expose effect-relative closure or complete verifier coverage cannot satisfy the negative-decision branch; UNKNOWN remains the only sound result.
